items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Remember when we went over to his house? Me, you, slow-dragging... Wait a minute. George Lewis.

ctx.x: Yeah. I didn't know that. Yeah, you know the... Remember when we went over to his house? Me, you, slow-dragging... Wait a minute. George Lewis.
I don't remember. No, I can't remember that. When was that? How long? Long ago? That's around the 40s. That far back.
